title: [field] Improve error message customization involving multiple validation rules

labels.name: type: enhancement
labels.description: It’s an improvement, but we can’t make up our mind whether it's a bug fix or a new feature.

labels.name: component: field
labels.description: Changes related to the field component.

body:
Sandbox: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/jovial-feather-knsgk4

When a field has multiple validation rules (e.g. `required`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern`) and you want to customize some but not all of the error messages, it's not possible to exclude the customized ones from being displayed in the default child-less `<Field.Error />`:

```jsx
<Field.Control
  required
  defaultValue=""
  pattern="[A-Za-zÀ-ž0-9#$%&*@.]+"
  minLength="2"
  maxLength="200"
/>
// this one will display the default `required` error message
<Field.Error />
// these 2 validityStates will display the error twice
<Field.Error match="patternMismatch">
  Alphanumeric characters and symbols only
</Field.Error>
<Field.Error match="tooShort">
  At least 2 characters
</Field.Error>
```

The errors using a default message would each have to use an individual component with `match` and no children (e.g. `<Field.Error match="valueMissing" />`) which is a bit annoying

Not sure if this will over-complicate `match` (esp with additional `boolean` support) but maybe support a function (returning `string | boolean`) as well?😅
```jsx
<Field.Error match={(validityState) => ['patternMismatch', 'tooShort'].includes(validityState)} />
```
